tongue.sense: The movable organ inside the mouth used in eating and speaking. Exclude language and projecting-object senses.

taste.sense: The sensory quality detected in the mouth from food or drink. Exclude preference, sampling and texture senses.

sugar.sense: Ordinary table sugar used as a food ingredient. Exclude a general chemical class or figurative sense. Do not assume that anything white or pleasant is sugar.

sweet.sense: The adjective for the taste characteristic of sugar. Exclude kind, pleasant, musical and other figurative senses.
